headline: Red Sox look to keep rolling as Tampa Bay arrives at Fenway
morning_brew: I have been watching this team claw their way back from the cellar, and I gotta say, they look like a completely different group lately. My neighbor Rick has been convinced for months that the baseball gods had a personal vendetta against our pitching staff, but even he has stopped his incessant grumbling now that we are stringing together some wins. It is nice to actually look forward to turning on the tube again, even if I still keep one eye on the arson squad just in case things go sideways.

We have a full day at the yard with a pair of contests against Tampa Bay, so I am planning on pacing myself. It is a marathon, not a sprint, and watching two full tilts in one day is the kind of stuff that makes me feel like a kid again, provided I do not fall asleep in the fifth like Uncle Carmine usually does. I hope the bats stay as hot as they have been during this run, because the Rays are always a pain in the side and we need to keep this momentum moving in the right direction.

My pops always told me that you never get too high on a streak, but man, it is hard not to get a little giddy when things finally click. I am grabbing a few extra Dunks runs today to make sure I am fueled up for the second game tonight. If we can take care of business at home, we might just be able to keep this thing going through the weekend and add a decent deposit to the Duck Boat fund.
